rationale: The authoritative PDF hash matches the supplied locator. The mandated boundary selects the deterministic sentence taking (4.17) to (4.20), so omissions concerning Householder execution, Q, R-hat, backward-error provenance, Model 1.5, and probability are not defects in this declaration.
